highlights.title: Sort your agents
highlights.line: The Agents grid and list can be sorted by name, model, role or project, by who needs you, or by recent activity.

highlights.title: Webhooks add tasks
highlights.line: A project's settings have Webhooks: calling a webhook's link adds a task that waits for you to hand out.

highlights.title: Real model names
highlights.line: Gemini, Grok and OpenAI agents now show their model by its real name, in plain language.

highlights.title: A rename reaches the agent's page
highlights.line: Renaming an agent now changes its name across its page: the title, its messages and the working line.

highlights.title: Steadier with many agents
highlights.line: Kosmos stays responsive while it delivers a message to many agents at once.
